name: Acolyte
desc: You served a temple, a cause, or a faith. What began as devotion grows, over time, into something closer to authority.

name: Criminal
desc: You lived outside the law. Contacts, instincts, and skills from that life stay with you — and grow sharper the longer you walk this road.

name: Folk Hero
desc: You come from common stock. Your defining moment stood against injustice. The people remember, and the memory lends its own strange weight.

name: Noble
desc: You were born into wealth and influence. Those doors remain open, and your inherited bearing becomes a tool in its own right.

name: Sage
desc: You spent years in study. Ancient languages, forgotten texts, and lost lore are familiar ground, and you unearth more each year you spend in the world.

name: Soldier
desc: You served in a military force. Camp routines and battlefield instincts shaped you. The habits deepen the longer you fight.

name: Outlander
desc: You come from the wilds, far from any city. You know the land in a way town-dwellers never will, and the land seems to know you back.

name: Entertainer
desc: You lived by performance. Crowds trusted you with their attention, and that attention becomes a resource you can wield in greater and greater ways.

name: Guild Artisan
desc: You were trained in a craft. The guild's protection and your tradecraft support you; mastery of your craft grows over time until the work becomes legendary.

name: Charlatan
desc: You lived by your wits and a smile. The art of becoming someone else at will grows subtler and more absolute the longer you practice.
